name: 23227-longprompt-qwen38bfp8-1gpu
model: AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_fp8_static. Public, ungated, ~8.5 GiB. FP8 W8A8, compressed-tensors, static per-tensor scales; do not substitute a differently quantized Qwen3-8B.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of an a3 node. Weights and KV together sit near 25 GiB at this operating point.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One card.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, dense. 36 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, bf16 KV at ~144 KiB/token.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 20% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap. 700 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, one turn per request: 7000 prompt tokens (stdev 200, clamped 6600-7400), exactly 32 output tokens with `ignore_eos`, temperature 0, no shared prefix.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing long reports for 16 concurrent users on a single 80GB GPU.
launch:
# The engine's launch line. Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is dropped, and a bool is a
# FLAG (`true` emits `--key`, `false` emits nothing). Environment variables cannot live here.

model-path: AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_fp8_static
tp-size: 1
piecewise-cuda-graph-compiler: inductor
disable-radix-cache: true
attention-backend: fa3

# `chunked-prefill-size` is left at the engine's derived 8192 and MUST NOT be raised: a prefill
# batch above that ceiling still runs, but outside the piecewise graph and without an error, so a
# larger value leaves a healthy server that is no longer running this configuration.
